'''Maxim Briand''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 4th at [[February 2000 Montreal tournament]] on 20 February 2000, according to Yannick Lapointe's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d275">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-02-21-montreal-quebec-02-20-2000d275/ montreal-quebec-02-20-2000], DeckTech (Yannick "Crusher" Lapointe, 21 February 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-02-21-montreal-quebec-02-20-2000d275/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
